note: Dated deal events for the payments universe and close peers, 2025-2026: IPOs and listings, acquisitions (announcement and completion), priced rounds and employee tenders. Values are headline deal values or valuations as the company states them; IPO sizes are computed from pricing releases; press-only prices are kept as reported rows and never charted.

rows.definition: Completion of Stripe's acquisition of the stablecoin platform Bridge, announced by Stripe on the day of closing.
rows.source_name: Stripe newsroom: Stripe completes Bridge acquisition
rows.caveat: Stripe states only that the acquisition closed on this date; it did not disclose a price. The deal was first announced in October 2024.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Bridge', dated February 4, 2025, first paragraph.

rows.definition: Purchase price for Bridge as reported by the press; not stated by Stripe.
rows.source_name: CNBC: Stripe closes $1.1 billion Bridge deal
rows.caveat: Press-reported price, US dollars. Stripe's own release gives no price, so this figure is shown as reported and never charted.
rows.curator_notes: Seen in the CNBC search extract: 'Stripe closed its $1.1 billion purchase of Bridge Network'. Article page itself not opened.

rows.definition: Valuation at which investors (and Stripe, through repurchases) bought shares from current and former employees.
rows.source_name: Stripe newsroom: tender offer for current and former employees (February 2025)
rows.caveat: Secondary tender valuation in US dollars (Stripe also gives EUR 87.3B). No new primary capital; the size of the tender was not disclosed.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'through a tender offer at a $91.5B (€87.3B) valuation. Alongside investors, Stripe will also repurchase shares.' first paragraph.

rows.definition: Post-money valuation of the Series C, a round that mixed primary and secondary funding.
rows.source_name: Business Wire: Mercury announces $300 million Series C at $3.5 billion valuation
rows.caveat: Post-money valuation in US dollars. The $300M round included secondary shares; Mercury did not split primary from secondary in the release.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'includes primary and secondary funding and values Mercury at $3.5 billion post-money', first paragraph, dated Mar 26, 2025.

rows.definition: Total value of the Worldpay purchase including $1.55B of anticipated tax assets; net purchase price $22.7B.
rows.source_name: Global Payments IR: agreements to acquire Worldpay and divest Issuer Solutions
rows.caveat: Announced headline value in US dollars, including anticipated tax assets (the net price is $22.7B). Paid partly with the Issuer Solutions business, so it is not an all-cash outlay.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'acquire Worldpay from GTCR and FIS for a net purchase price of $22.7 billion, or total value of $24.25 billion including $1.55 billion of anticipated tax assets', first paragraph after bullets.

rows.definition: Price at which Global Payments agreed to divest its Issuer Solutions business to FIS.
rows.source_name: Global Payments IR: agreements to acquire Worldpay and divest Issuer Solutions
rows.caveat: Enterprise value in US dollars. This is the other leg of the Worldpay swap: FIS pays partly with its Worldpay stake.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'divest its Issuer Solutions business to FIS for $13.5 billion', same paragraph as the Worldpay figure.

rows.definition: Equity value at $10.00 per share in cash for the take-private led by TPG; Corpay invests about $500M for a 33% stake.
rows.source_name: Corpay IR: Corpay invests alongside TPG to acquire AvidXchange
rows.caveat: Announced take-private value in US dollars. Corpay is a minority investor (33%) with an option to acquire 100%, not the sole buyer.
rows.curator_notes: Read '$10.00 per share in a cash transaction that values AvidXchange at $2.2 billion' and 'invest approximately $500 million for a 33% equity stake'.

rows.definition: Valuation of the Series F round; the $300M includes $150M of secondary share transfers.
rows.source_name: Airwallex newsroom: $300 million at a $6.2 billion valuation
rows.caveat: Valuation in US dollars. Half of the $300M round was secondary, so primary capital raised was $150M.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'completed a $300 million Series F funding round at a $6.2 billion valuation. The round includes $150 million in secondary share transfers.' dated 21 May 2025.

rows.definition: Gross offering size = 34,000,000 Class A shares x $31.00 public offering price (company and selling stockholders combined), before the underwriters' option.
rows.source_name: Circle IR: pricing of upsized initial public offering
rows.caveat: Gross IPO proceeds in US dollars, computed from the pricing release; 14.8M shares were sold by Circle and 19.2M by selling stockholders. Not a market value. Trading began on the NYSE on 2025-06-05.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'upsized initial public offering of 34,000,000 shares ... at a public offering price of $31.00 per share. Circle is offering 14,800,000 shares'. 34,000,000*31 = 1,054,000,000.

rows.definition: Gross offering size = 32,000,000 Class A shares x $27.00 public offering price, before the underwriters' option.
rows.source_name: Chime IR: pricing of initial public offering
rows.caveat: Gross IPO proceeds in US dollars, computed from the pricing release. Chime is a consumer neobank peer, outside the companies tracked on this page. Not a market value.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'initial public offering of 32,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $27.00 per share', Jun. 11, 2025. 32,000,000*27 = 864,000,000.

rows.definition: Valuation set by the Series E financing led by Founders Fund.
rows.source_name: PR Newswire: Ramp raises $200M Series E at $16B valuation
rows.caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Ramp; the round was capped at $200M.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'announced its Series E financing, bringing its valuation to $16 billion' and 'Total size was capped at $200 million', Jun 17, 2025.

rows.definition: Completion of the tender offer for Global Blue shares at $7.50 per common share in cash (about 97.37% tendered).
rows.source_name: Shift4 IR: Shift4 completes acquisition of Global Blue
rows.caveat: Completion of the tender offer; Shift4 states a per-share price ($7.50) but this release gives no total deal value. A squeeze-out of the remaining shares followed on 2025-08-18.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'successful completion of the tender offer ... for $7.50 per common share in cash', Jul 03, 2025.

rows.definition: Valuation set by the Series E-2 financing led by ICONIQ.
rows.source_name: PR Newswire: Ramp raises $500 million at $22.5 billion valuation
rows.caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Ramp, six weeks after the $16B Series E.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'announced its Series E-2, raising $500 million at a $22.5 billion valuation. ICONIQ led the round', July 30, 2025.

rows.definition: Gross offering size = 34,311,274 ordinary shares x $40.00 public offering price, before the over-allotment option.
rows.source_name: Klarna IR: pricing of its initial public offering
rows.caveat: Gross IPO proceeds in US dollars, computed from the pricing release. Only 5,000,000 shares were sold by Klarna; the rest by selling shareholders, so most proceeds did not go to the company. Not a market value. NYSE trading began 2025-09-10.
rows.curator_notes: Read '34,311,274 ordinary shares, of which 5,000,000 ordinary shares are sold by Klarna ... at a public offering price of $40.00'. 34,311,274*40 = 1,372,450,960.

rows.definition: Valuation on which Checkout.com's employee share buy-back programme is based.
rows.source_name: Checkout.com newsroom: employee share buy back and a new $12bn valuation
rows.caveat: Valuation in US dollars for a company-run employee buy-back, not a round priced by outside investors; the size of the buy-back was not disclosed.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'LONDON, UK - 26th September, 2025' and 'Checkout.com is announcing a share buy back. The programme is based on a new valuation of $12 billion.' Page metadata shows a later datePublished; date taken from the body.

rows.definition: Series A valuation as reported by the press from unnamed sources.
rows.source_name: Fortune: Tempo raises $500 million round
rows.caveat: Press report citing people familiar with the matter, US dollars; Tempo did not announce terms in a release read here. Shown as reported, never charted.
rows.curator_notes: Search extract only: 'raised $500 million in fresh funding in a Series A ... The round values Tempo at $5 billion', citing five people familiar.

rows.definition: Gross offering size = 36,924,406 Class A shares x $25.00 public offering price, before the underwriters' option.
rows.source_name: Navan IR: pricing of initial public offering
rows.caveat: Gross IPO proceeds in US dollars, computed from the pricing release; 30.0M shares sold by Navan, 6.9M by existing holders. Not a market value. Nasdaq trading began 2025-10-30.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'initial public offering of 36,924,406 shares ... at a public offering price of $25.00 per share. The offering consists of 30,000,000 shares ... sold by Navan'. 36,924,406*25 = 923,110,150.

rows.definition: Valuation following a $300M primary financing led by Lightspeed and an employee tender offer.
rows.source_name: PR Newswire: Ramp reaches $32 billion valuation
rows.caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Ramp; it covers both a $300M primary round and an employee tender, whose size was not disclosed.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'is now valued at $32B following a $300 million primary financing round and an employee tender offer. Lightspeed Venture Partners led', Nov. 17, 2025.

rows.definition: Valuation of the Series G round led by Addition.
rows.source_name: Airwallex newsroom: $330M Series G at $8B valuation
rows.caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Airwallex.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'raised $330 million in a Series G funding round, led by Addition ... The financing values Airwallex at $8 billion', 8 December 2025.

rows.counterparty: Worldpay (from GTCR and FIS); Issuer Solutions to FIS
rows.definition: Completion of the Worldpay acquisition and the simultaneous Issuer Solutions divestiture, as dated in the 8-K.
rows.source_name: Global Payments Form 8-K (Jan 12, 2026), Introductory Note
rows.caveat: The 8-K dates completion to January 9, 2026; Global Payments announced it in a press release on January 12, 2026. Price basis: $24.25B Worldpay and $13.5B Issuer Solutions enterprise valuations, subject to adjustments.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'Date of Report ... January 12, 2026 (January 9, 2026)' and 'On January 9, 2026, Global Payments Inc. ... completed its previously announced acquisition of Worldpay'. This conflicts with PLAN appendix, which records 2026-01-12 as completion; the 8-K Item text says Jan 9 and the press release is dated Jan 12.

rows.definition: Announced value of the stock-and-cash transaction for Brex.
rows.source_name: Capital One IR: Capital One to acquire Brex
rows.caveat: Headline value at signing in US dollars, part stock and part cash; consideration at closing differs with Capital One's share price and adjustments.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Brex, in a combination of stock and cash transaction valued at $5.15 billion', Jan. 22, 2026.

rows.definition: Valuation at which investors (and Stripe, through repurchases) buy shares from current and former employees.
rows.source_name: Stripe newsroom: 2025 annual letter and tender offer
rows.caveat: Secondary tender valuation in US dollars (Stripe also gives EUR 135B). No new primary capital; the tender size was not disclosed.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'through a tender offer at a $159B (€135B) valuation', second paragraph, February 24, 2026.

rows.definition: Maximum consideration: up to $1.8B including $300M in contingent payments.
rows.source_name: Mastercard press release: Mastercard to acquire BVNK
rows.caveat: An upper bound in US dollars ('up to'): about $1.5B fixed plus up to $300M in contingent payments. Do not chart as a point price.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'definitive agreement to acquire BVNK ... for up to $1.8 billion, including $300 million in contingent payments', March 17, 2026. Re-read 2026-10-03; $1.5B fixed is computed as 1.8B - 0.3B contingent.

rows.definition: Completion of Capital One's acquisition of Brex.
rows.source_name: Capital One newsroom: Capital One completes acquisition of Brex
rows.caveat: Completion date only; this release gives no closing consideration. Brex is part of Capital One from this date.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'APRIL 7, 2026 -- Capital One ... announced that it has completed its acquisition of Brex in a combination of stock and cash transaction.'

rows.definition: Primary listing of Wise Group plc Class A shares on Nasdaq (WSE), with a secondary listing kept on the London Stock Exchange.
rows.source_name: Wise Owner Relations: Wise debuts US listing on Nasdaq
rows.caveat: A listing move via a scheme of arrangement, not an IPO: no offering size or price is stated in the release. Wise is a 20-F filer reporting in US GAAP after the move.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'today announces its listing on Nasdaq, with trading to commence at 9:30am ET' and 'Wise also maintains a secondary listing on the London Stock Exchange', May 11, 2026.

rows.definition: Valuation of the Series D round led by TCV.
rows.source_name: Business Wire: Mercury raises $200 million Series D at $5.2B valuation
rows.caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Mercury; the release does not say pre- or post-money.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'today announced a $200 million Series D at a $5.2B valuation, led by TCV', dated 2026-05-20 on the Business Wire page.

rows.definition: Valuation set by a $750M primary financing led by ICONIQ, GIC and Ontario Teachers'.
rows.source_name: PR Newswire: Ramp raises Series F at $44 billion valuation
rows.caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Ramp. Press reports of later talks at about $60B are not company-confirmed and are not recorded here as an event.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'announced a $750 million primary financing round led by ICONIQ, GIC, and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, valuing the company at $44 billion', June 4, 2026.

rows.definition: Total transaction equity value at $7.40 per Payoneer share in cash.
rows.source_name: Nuvei: Nuvei to acquire Payoneer for $2.75 billion
rows.caveat: Approximate equity value in US dollars as stated in the joint release; expected to close in mid-2027 subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'for $7.40 per share in cash, representing a total transaction equity value of approximately $2.75 billion' and 'expected to close in mid-2027', JUNE 15, 2026. Payoneer is excluded from the Q9 universe count (pending acquisition). Re-read 2026-10-03.

rows.definition: Valuation of the Series H round led by Addition.
rows.source_name: Airwallex newsroom: $320 million Series H, valuation hits $11 billion
rows.caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Airwallex. Some press dated the news 2026-06-26 (Asia time); the release is dated 25 June 2026.
rows.curator_notes: Read '25 June 2026' and 'raised $320 million in Series H funding, bringing the company's valuation to $11 billion, up from its $8 billion valuation in December 2025'.

rows.definition: Completion of Mastercard's acquisition of BVNK.
rows.source_name: BVNK press: Mastercard completes acquisition of BVNK
rows.caveat: Completion date only; the closing release states no price. BVNK is part of Mastercard from this date.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'PURCHASE, N.Y., August 3, 2026 — Mastercard (NYSE: MA) today completed its acquisition of BVNK'.

rows.definition: Agreement by Stripe to acquire OpenRouter, an AI model gateway and routing platform.
rows.source_name: Stripe newsroom: Stripe agrees to acquire OpenRouter
rows.caveat: Signing date; Stripe did not disclose a price. OpenRouter is an AI-infrastructure target, not a payments company.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'today announced that it has agreed to acquire OpenRouter, a leading AI model gateway and routing platform', August 19, 2026.

rows.definition: Purchase price reported by the press from one person with knowledge of the agreement.
rows.source_name: The New York Times: Stripe buys OpenRouter for $7.5 billion
rows.caveat: Paywalled press report, US dollars, citing a single person familiar with the deal; Stripe has not confirmed it. Reuters separately reported slightly more than $8B. Never charted.
rows.curator_notes: Search extract: 'Stripe is paying $7.5 billion for OpenRouter, a person with knowledge of the agreement said.' No article text copied.

rows.definition: Deal value reported by the press from an anonymous source ('slightly more than $8 billion').
rows.source_name: Reuters: Stripe to buy OpenRouter
rows.caveat: Press report from one anonymous source, US dollars; it conflicts with the $7.5B figure reported by the New York Times. Kept side by side rather than averaged. Never charted.
rows.curator_notes: Search extract: 'a source familiar with the matter ... told Reuters it was worth slightly more than $8 billion.'

rows.definition: Agreement by Stripe to acquire Parafin, an embedded small-business credit platform.
rows.source_name: Stripe newsroom: Stripe agrees to acquire Parafin
rows.caveat: Signing date; no price disclosed, and closing is expected 'in the coming months' subject to regulatory clearances.
rows.curator_notes: Read 'today announced that it has agreed to acquire Parafin, a leading embedded financial products platform', September 30, 2026.

gaps.why: Stripe declined to disclose terms; no filing or release gives a price.
Stripe's release gives no price; only press figures ($7.5B NYT, >$8B Reuters) exist, kept as reported rows.
Stripe never stated the price; the $1.1B figure is press-reported.
Capital One's closing 8-K reportedly states about $2.56B cash plus 10,646,306 shares; seen only in a secondary summary of the filing, the 8-K itself was not opened, so no row was written.
Pricing releases give shares and price only; implied valuation needs the post-offering share count from each 424B4, which was not read in this pass.
No Tempo or Stripe release with round terms was found; the $500M at $5B figure is press-reported only.
Only the May 2025 agreement was read; the completion release was not opened in this pass.
Neither company discloses how many dollars changed hands in its employee tenders.
